response.justification: Bogdan Szabo’s resume demonstrates strong software engineering skills, particularly in web, mobile, and embedded systems, but lacks direct experience in hardware architecture, SoC/IP modeling, or AI accelerator optimization. His background is heavily focused on software development and general system design, with no evident exposure to deep-learning workload analysis, GPU architecture, or performance bottlenecks in AI accelerators. Additionally, he does not meet the educational or equivalent experience requirements for a Principal-level role in this domain.
strengths: Extensive experience in software engineering across multiple languages and domains (JavaScript/TypeScript, DLang, C++, etc.)
Proven ability to architect and optimize systems (e.g., GISCollective, low-latency microservices at Dunnhumby)
Strong background in system performance and optimization (e.g., pricing optimization at Optilyz, real-time data handling)
concerns: No demonstrated experience with SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerators, or hardware-software co-design
Lacks background in deep-learning workload optimization or GPU architecture analysis
Insufficient educational qualifications (Bachelor’s degree with ~12 years of experience, but no advanced degree or equivalent domain-specific experience for a Principal role)

key_factors.factor: AI accelerator and deep-learning workload optimization
